definitions.full: H7962. shalvah שַׁלְוָה noun feminine quietness, ease ; — absolute ׳שׁ Psa 122:7 +; construct שַׁלְוִת Ezek 16:49 ; Prov 1:32 ; plural suffix שַׁלְוֺתַ֫יִךְ Jer 22:21 ( שַׁלְוָתֵךְ Vrss Gie); — quietnees, peace , Prov 17:1 (opposed to רִיב ), Psa 122:7 , (|| שָׁלוֺם ); ease, careless security , Ezek 16:49 ( הַשְׁקֵט שַׁלְוַת ), Prov 1:32 ; prosperity , Jer 22:21 ; Dan 8:25 ; 11:21 , 24 ; ׳בְּ in (time of) security (of sudden attack), if not unawares (Thes Ew Hi Ke and others); compare literally out of quiet , i.e. suddenly, unawares (e.g. 1 Macc 1:30 = ἐξάπινα ), ᵑ7 שִׁלְיָא מִן Prov 3:25 ; 6:15 ( = מִּתְאֹם ), Psa 30:7 see [ שָׁ֫לוּ ]. Above I. שֵׁלָה see שְׁאֵלָה .

occurrences.englishText: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them.
Better is a dry morsel with quietness,
I spoke to you in your prosperity;
“ ‘ “Behold, this was the iniquity of your sister Sodom: pride, fullness of bread, and prosperous ease was in her and in her daughters. She also didn’t strengthen the hand of the poor and needy.

Through his policy he will cause deceit to prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart, and he will destroy many in their security. He will also stand up against the prince of princes; but he will be broken without hand.
“In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

In time of security he will come even on the fattest places of the province. He will do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers. He will scatter among them prey, plunder, and substance. Yes, he will devise his plans against the strongholds, even for a time.
